topic: Center of gravity, moment of inertia, radius of gyration
source: structure 1-70 / 71-140 / 141-228 updated.json (merged from old LEVEL 7 archive)

questions.q: 44. If the M.I of section about its axis is I and if the effective sectional area is A, then radius of gyration r is given by
questions.explain: The radius of gyration is defined as the distance from the axis at which the entire area could be concentrated to yield the same moment of inertia: I = Ar².

questions.q: 47. The moment of inertia of rectangular section is
questions.explain: For a rectangle of breadth B and depth D, the moment of inertia about the centroidal x-axis is BD³/12.

questions.q: 48. Ratio of moment of inertia (MOI) of a rectangular object about its x-axis to its base is
questions.explain: MOI about centroid is BD³/12. MOI about base is BD³/3. The ratio (BD³/12) / (BD³/3) = 1/4.
The moment of inertia for a circle of diameter d about any centroidal axis is πd⁴/64.

questions.q: 50. The moment of inertia of square section is
questions.explain: A square is a rectangle where B = D = a, so BD³/12 becomes a⁴/12.

questions.q: 51. The moment of inertia of elliptical section is
questions.explain: For an ellipse with major axis B and minor axis D, the formula follows the π/64 convention similar to circular sections.

questions.q: 52. The moment of inertia of triangular section about its c.g.
questions.explain: While the MOI of a triangle about its base is bh³/12, the MOI about the centroidal axis parallel to the base is bh³/36.

questions.q: 53. Along the neutral axis of a simply supported beam
questions.explain: By definition, the neutral axis is the layer where bending stress and strain are zero.

questions.q: 54. The ratio of the moment of inertia of a circular plate and a square plate for equal depth is
questions.explain: Comparing (πd⁴/64) for the circle and (a⁴/12) for the square where d = a leads to the mathematical ratio 3π/16.

questions.q: 55. The section modulus of a rectangular section is proportional to
options: square of the area of the section
product of the area and depth
product of the area and width
questions.explain: Section Modulus Z = BD²/6. Since Area A = BD, Z can be expressed as (A × D)/6, showing proportionality to area.

questions.q: 147. The term centre of gravity was introduced by
questions.explain: Archimedes was the first to provide a clear definition and method for finding the center of gravity of geometric shapes.
